spotlight.name: Bryce Deadmon
spotlight.title: Olympic Gold Medalist
spotlight.body: Track Houston alumnus Bryce Deadmon won Olympic gold in the men's 4x400m relay and bronze in the mixed relay at Tokyo 2020. At the 2022 World Championships in Eugene, he split 43.82 on the winning 4x400m. Before Texas A&M and Team USA, he was a Track Houston athlete.

college.headline: From Houston to everywhere.
college.body: Coupling academic performance with athletic accomplishment, Track Houston athletes have earned scholarships at more than 50 colleges and universities across the country.
